final_message:
I've drafted the Bluebird Bakery September 2026 trends report for the reviewer. It's in `evals/runs/v5-run-20261013/f_bb_from_zero_label/skill_output/`:
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.md` is the report, still marked DRAFT, with 8 commentary bullets.
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.json` holds every figure the report uses.

**Data quality: one mismatch.** In Mar 2026, the "Total for Professional Services" line says 2,225, but the accounts under it add up to 2,200 (a difference of 25). The report uses the 2,200; the reviewer needs to decide which is right. Two parts of the layout also had to be rebuilt: "Total Delivery" had no heading row, and "Charitable Donations" had no values and no total, so it's counted as zero. The commentary opens with all of this.

**Main points:**
- **Revenue:** 81,300, up 17.7% on August and 17.3% above the average of the six months before. 12,000 of that is Wholesale Accounts, a new revenue line with nothing in any earlier month. The export only covers January to September 2026, so there are no comparisons with last year or trailing-twelve-month figures.
- **Margin:** gross margin was 65.3%, up from 59.6% in August and the highest month in the export.
- **Costs:** Payroll & Benefits rose 5,000 (+28.4%), all of it wages (16,000 to 21,000). That pushed total operating expenses up 21.0% to 31,570. The draft leaves it to the reviewer whether this is the new normal or a one-month item.
- **Cash:** the bank balance is 37,600, down 1,800 on August and 10,800 lower than six months ago, even though the business made a profit every month. Equity also fell (54,660 to 44,940). The draft asks the reviewer what explains this, for example money taken out by the owners; the export doesn't show it.

**Mystery Shopper Program isn't new.** The cost tables show it rising "from 0", but that only means August was zero. It was also 400 in March and June, so it looks like a quarterly cost, and the draft leaves that for the reviewer to confirm.

**"Other" category:** Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates didn't match any expense category, so they're grouped as Other Opex.

The commentary leaves out one minor flag: Gift Cards revenue was negative (-300) in March 2026, probably refunds or credits. It's still listed in the report's flags section.
